description: This file defines the SugarCacheMemory class, a concrete implementation of the SugarCacheAbstract class, providing in-memory caching capabilities within the SuiteCRM application. It primarily sets a high priority and confirms backend availability, with cache operations effectively no-ops as the cache is temporary per request.

classes.name: SugarCacheMemory
classes.description: A subclass of SugarCacheAbstract that implements in-memory caching with a high priority and no persistence beyond the request lifecycle.

methods.name: useBackend
methods.description: Indicates that this cache backend is always available.
